purpose: Narrow successor requirements for the existing guarded normal merge; no new executable script and no execution authorization is inferred from this document.

finalFreeze.reason: Root must freeze after B16 integration and current documentation. Observed e90756cf/ff21fd47 and historical run44294650087 are not an accepted successor.
requiredValues: candidate commit and expected PR head ref
whole tree plus hosted/apple/android subtree IDs
actual checked-out PR merge commit and ordered parents [frozen base, candidate]
iPhone UITest source SHA-256 and exact17-method identity set
all Android instrumentation source hashes and exact116 class.method identities
acceptance scheme hash and full test selection
boot verifier SHA-256 and parser/fixture source hashes
final receipt paths, source-bound visual coverage and immutable evidence hashes
finalFreeze.rule: All five raw job checkouts must agree; their complete merge tree must equal the frozen candidate. Do not silently adopt a newer base/head or accept subtree equality as whole-tree equality.

requiredUpdates.action: Replace old path/source/run/base/hash constants only after final freeze; validate apple/android subtree fields as well as whole/hosted trees. Refresh source manifest after B16 and docs. Extend its narrow allowed paths for the actual boot verifier/parser/fixtures if recorded. Keep the exact clean-owner check and all-five actual-checkout equality.
requiredUpdates.doNot: Do not use the existing failed receipt, current generic native compile or focused attempts as full acceptance.

requiredUpdates.action: Change Android captureCount20 to22 and require the exact source-defined capture set. Reconcile114 ordinary cases plus1 preview TLS-boundary plus1 HTTPS case; the runner floor105 is not acceptance. Preserve17 exact-once iPhone methods and reconcile raw logs with xcresult. No changed subset, skips or assumption outcomes.
requiredUpdates.evidence: CI checklist android/iphone/sourceReview sections; source reads at ff21fd47 confirm the two new capture callsites.

requiredUpdates.action: Keep schema1 collector wrapper but additionally require and semantically validate the actual runner boot JSON and its verified archive-member inputs. Require the fixture, boot and full UI steps to pass. Re-evaluate the exact-source strict parser on retained raw inputs offline when implementing/running the later guard. A green step, exits0 or Booted alone is insufficient.

Require a root visual row to join a source-bound media index and exact member bytes of the accepted CI archive. Current verify_file(path,sha) only proves an arbitrary local file under CI; it does not prove artifact membership or test association.

Immediately before readiness transition and again before merge, recheck live run/attempt/jobs/artifact IDs/digests/unexpired state, PR head/base/repository and base ref against the frozen values. Do not auto-update expectedBaseSHA. Invoke only normal gh pr merge with --merge and --match-head-commit candidate, existing authorized PR1 and explicit repo.
requiredUpdates.limitation: Installed gh help confirms match-head-commit binds the PR head, not an atomic expected-base comparison. A base advance between read and merge is a residual race; post-merge checks detect it after mutation. Do not claim atomic prevention.

requiredUpdates.action: Keep inert default and explicit --merge-now; all source/CI/visual guards pass before any gh pr ready/merge mutation. Record mutation intent and command exit/stdout/stderr even if the CLI fails or times out, then reconcile live PR state read-only without automatic retry. Verify merged/closed PR, exact accepted head/target base, merge commit ordered parents[frozen base,candidate] and whole tree==accepted tree; only then write the final receipt exclusively.
requiredUpdates.doNot: No admin, force, squash, rebase, branch deletion, auto-merge flag, repeated mutation or automatic revert. Unexpected post-mutation state is a recorded inspection requirement, not an earlier preflight rejection.

androidCaptures.rule: Every expected image must have actual readable PNG bytes, recorded dimensions/size/hash, a unique source callsite/test association and a matching verified artifact member. Some capture helpers log optional failure without failing the test; missing captures still block this acceptance gate. Extra diagnostic media must not substitute for a missing expected capture.

exactFieldChecks.checkoutSHA: actual tested PR merge commit, not run.head_sha by assumption
exactFieldChecks.selectedDevice: unique matching available Booted device; no availabilityError

runnerBootRequirements.rawReconciliation: Raw log has exactly one terminal Finished record, no failed/unknown/malformed statuses and no trailing result other than Finished. Cross-check inventory contents and source-selected/runtime device; unproved clone substitution is not accepted.
runnerBootRequirements.inputBinding: Runner inputs.bootLog and inputs.deviceInventory byte counts/SHA-256 must equal the actual accepted archive members and local extracted bytes. Runner absolute paths are provenance strings, not local file paths to follow.
runnerBootRequirements.emptyDiagnosticException: career-iphone-boot-devices.stderr may legitimately be0bytes. Allow that exact diagnostic member to be empty with the empty-file digest; do not relax nonempty boot log, inventory or verification JSON checks.
runnerBootRequirements.collectorCompatibility: bootReadiness.verification remains a relative path string plus verificationSHA256. Its wrapper binds run/job/head/actualCheckout, raw job digest, strict runner receipt/member digest, verifier source and actual invocation. Do not replace artifacts[].workflowRun object with a string.
runnerBootRequirements.sourceEvidence: apple/Checks/verify-simulator-boot.py:85–100,138–147; workflow:263–280,325–337. Current negative local proof rejected Status3 despite exits0/Booted before any test.

visualMemberContract.schema: Keep root-owned visual schema1; require a new explicit memberBindingVersion:1 and actual member/index fields so old path-only receipts cannot satisfy the successor.
visualMemberContract.index: Collector supplies a hash-bound artifact-member/media index for the members relied on by acceptance. Each row records runId, jobId, artifactId, archiveSHA256, exact normalized archive member path, local extracted path, bytes, SHA-256, dimensions/type and actual test/capture identity.
visualMemberContract.requiredJoin: Exactly one reviewed row -> exactly one index row -> exactly one regular member in the accepted archive. Recomputed SHA-256(member bytes) == index SHA == extracted-file SHA == root visual SHA; byte count and image dimensions also agree. The artifact ID/archive digest/run/job and passing actual test association agree with complete-source-acceptance.json.
visualMemberContract.safePathRule: Reject absolute/traversal/duplicate-normalized member names and symlink substitution. The extracted path must resolve to its indexed member under that artifact extraction directory, not merely anywhere beneath CI.
visualMemberContract.coverage: Artifact completeness requires all22Android captures and current iPhone attachment/source-set reconciliation, including30-profile-role-shortcut and31-profile-contact-reuse. Root must explicitly declare and satisfy its current visual coverage set for both platforms; two arbitrary files are not a sufficient coverage declaration. This spec does not invent a new universal requirement that every optional diagnostic attachment receive human review.
visualMemberContract.derivedImages: Contact sheets, crops or video frames may supplement review with declared source/transform evidence. Their hashes are not the original archive-member hashes and must not impersonate exact member captures.
visualMemberContract.reviewOutcome: Require root status passed, no unresolved blocking findings and current exact candidate/tree/run. Independent review files remain supplemental, separately hashed, and cannot replace root visual ownership.

normalMergeLimit: Installed gh pr merge --help also documents special merge-queue behavior. Confirm the target still supports the intended direct normal merge before mutation. If queue/pending state intervenes, do not call it merged, bypass rules with --admin, or silently treat it as accepted automatic completion.

evidenceReferences.source: Read-only installed gh pr merge --help in this review
evidenceReferences.claim: match-head-commit binds the head; no expected-base flag shown; queue behavior is separately documented.

reviewLimits: No old/new guard executed and no old guard mutated. No CI/native/build/UI/deployment actions by this reviewer.
No current full success receipt or final run/candidate freeze exists in this specification.
Final artifact/index/visual schemas must be reconciled against actual collected files; conceptual field mappings are proposed here, not fabricated completed receipts.
The verifier and B16 source reviews do not imply a healthy runtime or current UI acceptance.
Normal GitHub head binding does not provide an atomic base compare-and-swap; post-merge mismatch handling is observational and cannot undo a mutation.
